# Voice Gateway v2 API Reference

<!-- Code generated by gen-api-sdk; DO NOT EDIT. -->

RESTful JSON signaling API served at `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/`.

Type notation: `JSONValue` means any valid JSON value.

## Voice

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/choices` | Lists available voice choices and their supported transports. |  | `VoiceChoicesResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/text/ticket` | Authorizes a browser text-session upgrade with a short-lived, single-use ticket. | `VoiceTextTicketReq` | `VoiceTextTicketResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/offer` | Exchanges a WebRTC SDP offer for an answer, opening a voice gateway session. | `VoiceRTCOfferReq` | `VoiceRTCAnswerResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/{sessionID}/diagnostics` | Returns structured WebRTC connectivity diagnostics for a voice bridge session. | `VoiceRTCDiagnosticsReq` | `VoiceRTCDiagnosticsResp` |
| POST | `/api/voicegateway/v2/voice/rtc/{sessionID}` | Closes a WebRTC voice bridge session. |  | `StatusResp` |

## Errors

All errors return:

```json
{
  "error": { "code": "<CODE>", "message": "..." },
  "details": { ... }
}
```

| HTTP | Code |
|------|------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` |
| 503 | `VOICE_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE` |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` |
| 500 | `VOICE_OFFER_FAILED` |

### InterruptSource

InterruptSource identifies why a voice gateway turn was interrupted.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `user` | InterruptSourceUser means user speech interrupted the assistant. |
| `tool` | InterruptSourceTool means tool execution was cancelled. |

### MessageKind

MessageKind identifies a voice gateway WebRTC data-channel message.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `session.setup` | MessageKindSessionSetup starts a provider-neutral voice session. |
| `context.update` | MessageKindContextUpdate sends provider-neutral text context to the session. |
| `user.message` | MessageKindUserMessage appends completed user text and asks the assistant to respond. |
| `tool.result` | MessageKindToolResult returns the result of a tool call. |
| `turn.cancel` | MessageKindTurnCancel asks the gateway to cancel the current turn. |
| `session.close` | MessageKindSessionClose asks the gateway to close the session. |
| `session.ready` | MessageKindSessionReady reports that the gateway session is ready. |
| `session.status` | MessageKindSessionStatus reports startup progress before session.ready. |
| `session.usage` | MessageKindSessionUsage reports cumulative provider usage for this connection. |
| `transcript.delta` | MessageKindTranscriptDelta streams transcript text. |
| `transcript.draft` | MessageKindTranscriptDraft replaces provisional user text, without committing it. |
| `assistant.text.delta` | MessageKindAssistantTextDelta streams assistant text. |
| `reasoning.delta` | MessageKindReasoningDelta streams provider reasoning text. |
| `speech.started` | MessageKindSpeechStarted reports that speech output started. |
| `speech.ended` | MessageKindSpeechEnded reports that speech output ended. |
| `tool.call` | MessageKindToolCall asks the client to execute a tool. |
| `turn.status` | MessageKindTurnStatus reports gateway work on the current turn. |
| `interrupted` | MessageKindInterrupted reports an interruption. |
| `error` | MessageKindError reports a gateway error. |

| `client` | SpeechLocationClient uses the client's speech facilities. |

### VoiceTransport

VoiceTransport identifies how clients communicate with a voice choice.

|-------|-------------|
| `text` | VoiceTransportText carries text with client speech recognition and synthesis. |

### SpeechConfig

SpeechConfig selects recognition and synthesis independently. Empty fields use
transport defaults: WebRTC uses each configured gateway stage; text uses client
speech. Explicit unsupported selections fail before model initialization.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `input` | `SpeechLocation` |  |  |
| `output` | `SpeechLocation` |  |  |

VoiceChoice describes a selectable backend without exposing its credentials.

VoiceChoiceDefault names the choice a transport family uses when a session
omits choiceID. A family is one transport: WebRTC audio for gateway speech,

|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `transport` | `VoiceTransport` | Transport is the family this default applies to. | yes |
| `id` | `string` | ID names a choice that offers Transport. | yes |

### VoiceConfig

VoiceConfig describes provider-neutral voice preferences.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` | Name is the requested provider-specific voice name. Empty uses the provider default. |  |
| `language` | `string` | Language is the requested BCP 47 language tag, such as "en-US" or "fr-CA".
Empty defaults to "en-US". Invalid tags fail session setup. The gateway
instructs the assistant to use this language and supplies recognition hints
where supported. Speech models determine available languages and accents;
local server ASR/TTS adapters do not expose per-session language controls. | yes |

| `name` | `string` | Name is the tool name the assistant uses in tool.call messages. | yes |

| `parameters` | `JSONValue` | Parameters is a JSON Schema object describing the tool arguments. When
present, it must declare "type": "object". | yes |

### SessionSetup

SessionSetup is the client message that initializes a voice session.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind must be "session.setup". | yes |
| `voice` | `VoiceConfig` | Voice contains the requested voice and language. | yes |
| `tools` | `ToolDeclaration[]` | Tools declares the client-side tools the assistant may call. | yes |
| `context` | `Context` | Context provides initial instructions or text context for the session. | yes |
| `includeReasoning` | `boolean` | IncludeReasoning requests optional provider reasoning output for this session.
It does not enable thinking or change reasoning effort. |  |
| `speech` | `SpeechConfig` | Speech selects the owner of recognition and synthesis for this session. |  |
| `recognitionModelID` | `string` | RecognitionModelID selects a recognitionModels entry for a composable LLM.
Omitted uses the first available entry when input is gateway-owned.
It must be omitted for client-owned recognition and indivisible choices. |  |
| `synthesisModelID` | `string` | SynthesisModelID selects a synthesisModels entry for a composable LLM.
Omitted uses the first available entry when output is gateway-owned.
It must be omitted for client-owned synthesis and indivisible choices. |  |

### SessionStatus

SessionStatus reports startup progress. Gateways repeat it at least every five
seconds while loading or waiting for capacity. Clients may refresh their
setup timeout on receipt; only session.ready enables microphone input.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "session.status". | yes |
| `message` | `string` | Message is a short user-visible description of startup work. | yes |

### TokenUsage

TokenUsage contains provider-reported counts. Nil means unavailable. Cached
and reasoning counts are breakdowns, never additional tokens to sum with input
and output; providers differ in how they account for reasoning output.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `inputTokens` | `int64` | InputTokens includes the input processed again on each model request. |  |
| `outputTokens` | `int64` | OutputTokens counts generated output as reported by the provider. |  |
| `cachedTokens` | `int64` | CachedTokens is the reported cached-input breakdown. |  |
| `reasoningTokens` | `int64` | ReasoningTokens is the reported reasoning breakdown. |  |

### SessionUsage

SessionUsage is an idempotent snapshot for one gateway connection. Clients
replace snapshots with the same SessionID and carry totals across automatic
reconnects in one conversation. Missing reports are excluded from totals;
this is observed model usage, not a billing statement or ASR/TTS accounting.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "session.usage". | yes |
| `sessionID` | `string` | SessionID identifies the gateway connection that owns these totals. | yes |
| `provider` | `string` | Provider identifies the generation provider. | yes |
| `model` | `string` | Model identifies the generation model. | yes |
| `totals` | `TokenUsage` | Totals sums all reported responses, including tool continuations. | yes |
| `lastResponse` | `TokenUsage` | LastResponse contains the latest reported response counts, when available. |  |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID identifies the response observed by this report. It is opaque
and unique across gateway connections. Empty means the provider did not
supply a reliable response association. |  |
| `responseUsage` | `TokenUsage` | ResponseUsage contains counts for ResponseID in this report only. Unlike
LastResponse, it is never carried forward into context-only reports. |  |
| `contextTokens` | `int64` | ContextTokens is the latest reported context size, never summed. |  |
| `contextWindow` | `int64` | ContextWindow is the latest reported context capacity. |  |

### TranscriptDelta

TranscriptDelta is a gateway message that streams transcript text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "transcript.delta". | yes |
| `speaker` | `Speaker` | Speaker identifies who produced this transcript text. | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental transcript fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |
| `draft_id` | `string` | DraftID atomically replaces the matching user draft when this text commits. |  |

### TranscriptDraft

TranscriptDraft is an ephemeral full-text user hypothesis for one microphone
utterance. Revisions replace text for ID. Empty Text clears only that ID.
Drafts never enter conversation history, activity logs, or recovery context.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` |  | yes |
| `id` | `string` |  | yes |
| `text` | `string` |  | yes |

### AssistantTextDelta

AssistantTextDelta is a gateway message that streams assistant text.
Each fragment appends to previously emitted text; it never replaces it.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "assistant.text.delta". | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental assistant text fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |

### ReasoningDelta

ReasoningDelta is a gateway message that streams provider reasoning text.

Reasoning is not speech and not a transcript statement. A client decides
whether to display it, but must not speak it or replay it as recovery context.
The gateway includes it in the session activity log.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "reasoning.delta". | yes |
| `text` | `string` | Text is an incremental reasoning fragment. | yes |
| `responseID` | `string` | ResponseID is the opaque gateway-scoped response identity. Assistant
text and its usage share this value; user text and uncorrelated providers
omit it. Separate response IDs must not be merged into one transcript entry. |  |

### TurnStatus

TurnStatus is a gateway message that reports work on the current turn.

Backends that cannot observe their own progress never send it. Speech
output and tool calls take display precedence over the reported state.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kind` | `MessageKind` | Kind is "turn.status". | yes |
| `state` | `TurnState` | State is the gateway work in progress; idle ends the turn, including
one that produced no speech. | yes |
